summary.note: In-sample scan of the same bot-live history. Not out of sample. PnL assumes $1 stake hold to $1: win += 1/ask-1, loss -= 1. Voids and unresolved excluded from WR. Missing market_resolutions filled only when the last in-window book is pinned (bid>=0.99 vs ask<=0.01).

predicate.spread: if bestBid!=null, ask-bid > spreadMax rejects; null bid skips spread gate
predicate.depth: computeSize($1, ask, maxShares=30) >= 5 and (bestAskSize==null or bestAskSize>=size)
predicate.side: cheaper ask; tie goes to UP (outcomeIndex 0) because up.ask <= down.ask
predicate.first: first tick in ts order that passes all gates; one entry per window
predicate.notApplied: earlyLowDropEntryEnabled is false in preset (separate entry mode, not swept). Exits (stop/trailing/wait-and-see) stay off because payoff model is hold to resolution. No min-elapsed gate exists on the base entry.
